title: Server-Statistics
description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.8 – 1.21.11 that automatically tracks your kills, deaths, and K/D ratio for every server you join.
body:
A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.8 – 1.21.11 that automatically tracks your kills, deaths, and K/D ratio for every server you join.
Each server gets its own separate stat sheet — your Hypixel numbers stay separate from your SMP numbers, which stay separate from your mcpvp.club numbers. Stats are saved between game launches so you never lose your progress.
Open the menu with the H key (rebindable), or click the Server Stats button on the title screen or pause menu. You'll see a list of every server you've played on with K / D / K-D shown for each, plus a detailed view for any server you click on. To use the mod you need to have installed Fabric API.
